Economy · India

Stock Markets Dip Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Oil Price Spikes

Indian stock markets experienced a decline in early trade, influenced by renewed tensions between the US and Iran and a subsequent spike in crude oil prices. While some analysts suggest this dip may be temporary, citing potential economic growth and declining market volatility, others highlight geopolitical factors as primary drivers of the downturn. Foreign institutional investors showed some buying activity amidst the fluctuations.
